meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline_en: Query and cross-analyze multiple bioinformatics databases through one unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bio databases in one consistent workflow

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能在 Python 里统一调用约 40 个生物信息学数据库服务:查蛋白序列与注释、通路、化合物,还能做数据库之间的 ID 转换和 BLAST 序列比对。
howto.when: 当你要在一个流程里跨库查询(如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等)、做 ID 映射或跑序列比对时触发;单个库的快速查询用 gget,序列与文件操作用 biopython。

howto.what_en: Lets Claude query roughly 40 bioinformatics databases from Python: protein sequences and annotations, pathways, compounds, plus cross-database ID mapping and BLAST searches through one consistent API.
howto.when_en: When a workflow spans multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, etc.), needs identifier mapping, or runs sequence similarity searches. Single-database lookups use gget; sequence/file work uses biopython.
